{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or neutral (sentiment ≤ 0.33) to correct for overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent upward spikes in history (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment ≥ 0.50).",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment strongly bullish.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if true outcome is consistently below model forecast over last 5 days (indicating overestimation).",
    "Add lag correction: if true outcome is 2-3 days behind model forecast, adjust forecast downward by 2-5% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "Avoid sharp upward overshoots after recent spikes — cap forecast increase to 5% above prior peak unless sentiment is strongly bullish (>0.67).",
    "When sentiment is weak (0.00–0.33), use 30-day moving average as baseline to avoid overreacting to short-term noise."
  ]
}
